summary: Iter120 — Staff Offline Sync Queue E2E + Taxi Map regression. Backend 8/8 PASS (auth-guard, batch sync, idempotency, status, partial dedup, validation). Frontend E2E PASS: offline simulation via context.set_offline + navigator.onLine override → click shift-end-btn → event queued in localStorage `staff_offline_clock_queue` with valid client_event_id (UUID), action=clock_out, source=offline_sync; offline badge ('Offline') visible; offline toast 'Ausgecheckt (offline) — Wird synchronisiert sobald wieder online.' shown. Going online → queue cleared (length 1→0) after auto-sync (debounce 1500ms + network). Taxi Map regression PASS: /taxi → booking sheet → mapContainer renders 414x896, position:absolute, inset:0, canvasCount=1, Berlin tiles (Hackesche Höfe, Spandauer Vorstadt) visible — iter119 CSS-Spezifitäts-Fix holds.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/staff_offline_sync.py: idempotency key = (client_event_id, staff_id) — perfectly scoped per-staff and prevents cross-tenant collision. Good.
routes/staff_offline_sync.py:56 sorted by captured_at before insert — preserves chronological order even when client sends out-of-order events. Good.

useOfflineClockQueue.js:65-87 flushQueue correctly treats BOTH 'synced' AND 'duplicate' results as successfully-handled and filters them out of the queue — this is the right behavior for safe resync; without it a duplicate would loop forever.
useOfflineClockQueue.js:138-140 mount-time scheduleSync covers the case where the user opens the portal already online with a leftover queue from a previous session. Solid.

StaffPortalPage.jsx:172-179 short-circuits to enqueue when navigator.onLine === false (no network attempt). Lines 193-199 also enqueue on fetch network failure (5xx/timeout). The catch-all does NOT enqueue on HTTP 4xx — correct, otherwise validation errors would queue forever.

Minor observation: the success toast after online-sync ('X Buchung(en) synchronisiert') was animated out before the 5s screenshot tick — purely a timing observation, not a defect. Queue clearance (1→0) confirms the sync happened.

TaxiPage.jsx:563-569 inline-style fix (position:absolute;inset:0) is necessary because mapbox-gl.css ships `.mapboxgl-map { position: relative }` which has equal specificity to Tailwind utilities but is loaded later — inline style is the cleanest deterministic override.
Regression check stays green at 414x896 mobile viewport — the bug from iter119 cannot resurface as long as the inline style stays in place.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (offline-queue persistence + auto-sync + map regression all verified)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Offline sync is end-to-end stable. Key things to know for future tests: (1) localStorage key is `staff_offline_clock_queue`; flushQueue treats both 'synced' and 'duplicate' results as successfully-removed → safe to call repeatedly. (2) For Playwright offline simulation use BOTH `page.context.set_offline(True)` AND `Object.defineProperty(navigator,'onLine',{get:()=>false}); window.dispatchEvent(new Event('offline'))` — the hook reads navigator.onLine directly. (3) Sync debounce is 1500ms, plus network roundtrip — allow ≥3s after `online` event before asserting queue cleared. (4) Taxi map regression: assert `[data-testid=taxi-map-container]` or `.mapboxgl-map` has height>200 and canvasCount>=1; iter119 inline-style fix is the gating change. (5) Backend pytest module: /app/backend/tests/test_offline_sync_iter120.py — 8 tests, ~3.5s wall-time, reusable as regression.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. The offline-sync flow design (UUID client_event_id + server-side idempotency on (client_event_id, staff_id)) is correct and exercised. The taxi-map iter119 fix is still effective.
